title: Cheesy Basil Pesto Pull-Apart Rolls
changes_from_base: Home-made basil pesto in the dough and coating each ball, finished with mozzarella and hard cheese.
summary: Green-flecked pull-apart rolls rolled in home-made pesto and baked under bubbling mozzarella.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
cling film or a clean tea towel
food processor or pestle and mortar
23 x 33 cm baking dish or lined baking tray

steps.title: Pesto
steps.text: Blitz the basil, pine nuts, 20 g cheese and garlic to a rough paste, then work in the oil to make a loose sauce. Set aside 2 tbsp for the dough.

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and 25 g cheese, then add the 2 tbsp oil, the reserved pesto and the warm milk and stir to a shaggy dough. Rest 5 min, then knead about 6 min, until smooth and bouncy.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 45-60 min, until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide into 12 pieces of about 65 g and round each tightly. Roll each ball in the remaining pesto and arrange them in the greased dish, just touching.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover and leave 30-45 min, until puffy. Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Scatter over the mozzarella and the last 25 g cheese and bake 20-25 min, until the cheese is bubbling and browned; the centre roll reads 88-90 °C. Cool 10 min before pulling apart.

tips: Toast the pine nuts gently; they burn in seconds.
Make the pesto just before using so it stays green.
Use a vegetarian hard cheese if you need the rolls to be vegetarian.
storage: Keep in the fridge for up to 2 days and reheat at 180 °C for 6-8 min; freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
